info.name: Restaurant Booking API
info.description: Local API (Go + Postgres). Start it with `go run ./cmd/server` from backend/. Seed passwords are password123.

item.name: 1. Auth

request.description: Set the signupEmail collection variable to an address you can open. The verify link is emailed.
Copy the token= part of the emailed link into the verifyToken variable. Sending it twice gives 404.

item.description: Run the login requests first: they save the tokens every other request uses.

item.name: 3. Staff

request.description: Works from 30 min before the start until the end of the sitting. Otherwise 409.

item.name: Coastal staff on a Spice booking (404)

item.description: Actions use {{reservationId}} (set by Book in the Customer folder). Book a fresh one first: a cancelled booking answers 409. Seat / extend / complete / no-show depend on the time of day, so they have no fixed expected status.
